context: Checkpoint 2026-07-24 (25th). AUTH Slice 1 LANDED + proven live: opt-in per-device auth gate on the sidecar (packages/tractor/src/sidecar/auth.rs + mod.rs layer, mirrors CORS). REFARM_AUTH_POLICY unset → gate off (byte-identical to before); set → every request needs Authorization: Bearer <token> whose sha256 is enrolled in the policy, else 401. Proven: no policy→200+farm-ask ok; policy set→no/wrong cred 401, valid 200. Fail-closed (broken policy = deny-all); stores only token sha256. Commit af560a9a; all gates green. Also this session: workspace-access-contract-v1 (the authorization block, commit 6f3f5bb6), the security spec (docs/.../2026-07-24-sovereign-auth-workspaces-design.md), chat-over-tunnel fix, PWA audit. Daemon currently running DEFAULT (gate off) so clients keep working.
